precedence: studio/USER_RULES.md and the current job brief
studio/CURRENT_STATE.json for status; REFERENCE_INDEX.json for approvals
selected style contract and shared production policy
historical guides and old handoffs: background only

storage.github: Current source, rules, project profiles, registries, small approved voice reference; version-controlled history.
storage.drive: Large original media, finished films, raw voice, review evidence and versioned recovery ZIPs. Navigation/boot kit here mirrors this release, not an independent policy.
storage.scratch: Temporary downloads, caches and renders are disposable. No stage is durably saved until its source and media checkpoint are published and independently verified.

distribution.default_branch_audit: main was not the current production branch at this audit. Do not assume a default clone is current. Respect any platform-locked working branch; import reviewed source without switching to a forbidden branch.

architecture.rule: Extend the common engine; one profile per film, never clone an engine per topic/style.

not_guaranteed: Portable executable voice identity from a local voice number
Commercial rights from an attribution or government-hosted source
Availability of files referenced only by old /home/user/build paths
